array_order.endpoints: FIT authority row order; base then donor
array_order.records: v2 donor-manifest ordinal order after applicability filter

retained_byte_contract.formula: fixed + retained_site(R_H,R_Q) + selected + necessity + redundancy + reader
retained_byte_contract.non_array_metrics: canonical_JSON_float64_scalars; not counted as raw numeric arrays

runtime_and_publication.intervention_call_semantics: every manifest forward reruns each target prompt from tokens through the full native prefix, applies the registered one- or two-site hook using only cached donor H/Q vectors, and continues the same forward; no full-sequence boundary or suffix cache exists

interventions.full_state_ceiling: identity-projector replacement r_target <- r_donor at exactly one registered coordinate
interventions.reader_rescue: after H neutralization, insert natural-donor selected-Q coefficient
interventions.reader_reset: after H donor patch, replace selected-Q coefficient with native-target Q coefficient
interventions.sufficiency: r_target + U@U.T@(r_donor-r_target) at exactly the registered token coordinate
interventions.two_site_order: ascending boundary; second neutralization uses current activation after first

runtime_and_publication.model_execution_surface: future hash-bound full/suffix localization implementation with native-forward equivalence canary; facade validation only because its production dispatch shape is not this manifest's variable batch shape

temporary_peak_storage.receipt_canary: hash-bound non-task canary at batch192_length8_rank4 with two forward graphs, one backward, one QR, one Adam update, float32, and the exact future producer/model execution surface
temporary_peak_storage.runtime_guard: reset and read CUDA peak counters around every major stage; exceeding the separately approved receipt-derived cap or any OOM is hard_abort without scientific terminal or partial publication
temporary_peak_storage.why_no_exact_allocator_number: PyTorch graph/allocator/workspace overhead depends on the future implementation and CUDA stack; inventing a byte total before that code exists would not be an auditable bound

discovery.eligible_H: all mandatory H answer-changing cells available; paired A1/A2 direction >=0.80
discovery.eligible_Q: eligible_H conditions plus all four C<->ordinary-singular cells available
discovery.selected_H: largest float64 median-seed joint objective; tie earlier boundary
discovery.selected_Q: v2 section 8 T_b onset rule; fallback finite argmax tie earlier and reader forced unresolved
discovery.top_two_Q: descending raw float64 T_b; tie earlier boundary

spectral.operator: A v = mean sigma/2 * [g*(delta^T v)+delta*(g^T v)]
spectral.record_weighting: same unweighted signed affirmative DISCOVERY cell means as the corresponding H/Q joint objective; omit controls and A_C
